name: P-006 live: the slack package installs through the Cupboard install route and its card then appears on Settings -> Integrations, carrying the declared app registration and masked credentials
command: VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_DB=1; rewrite https://github.com/Papercusp/ to the local libs/ checkout inside the isolated operator only; open /settings/integrations and count Slack provider cards; POST /api/cupboard/install-plugin {githubUrl:'https://github.com/Papercusp/papercusp', listingRef:'plugins/slack'} then re-POST with acceptCapabilities + expectedReview; reopen the page; read the Slack card's app-registration block (Create Slack app href, Copy definition) and credentials form (masked inputs, configured flags)
summary: verify-tauri-headless run 20261011T105721Z-1437229 verdict=pass (passed=3 failed=0 blocked=0 skipped=0), isolated DB, superproject 853ced529e, libs/papercusp 7c0fa73eec. Before the install the page had no Slack card. The install went through the same Cupboard route a listing uses: the first POST returned 409 with a review naming provider slack, the accepted second POST returned 200. With no app update the Slack card then rendered, its Create Slack app link carried Slack's new-app manifest (name Papercusp, socket mode on) beside a Copy definition button, and its credentials form showed exactly two masked inputs, app_token and bot_token, both unconfigured. The bug-triage pack install and the Slack message drill are NOT claimed here (P-008, D-010).

assertions.evidence: CARD_BEFORE_INSTALL count=0 on /settings/integrations before any install (D-015: the bundled project root no longer loads distribution:cupboard packages).

INSTALL_SLACK first=409 second=200 providerId=slack; review.provider {id:slack, runtime:daemon, datatypes:[chat-message], capabilities:[chat.channels, chat.reply, ingress.normalize], egressHosts:[slack.com]}; result ok:true name slack version 0.1.0 installedTo the isolated global plugin root.
OK Slack card after install: the provider card selector with text 'Slack' rendered after reopening the page, same running app build.

APP_REGISTRATION create=true name="Papercusp" socket=true: the Create Slack app href is https://api.slack.com/apps?new_app=1&manifest_json=... and its manifest parses with display_information.name Papercusp and settings.socket_mode_enabled true.
Credentials form has exactly 2 input[type=password]; CREDENTIALS app_token:false,bot_token:false (both declared fields, neither configured).

limitations: The Cupboard listing is resolved from the local libs/ checkout through a git url rewrite scoped to the isolated operator; publishing the package to a public repo is P-011 (D-014).
Create Slack app is checked by its href, not clicked, because a click hands the URL to the system browser; the click-to-opener path is unit-tested.
SPEC-R-2-P-001's second half (a value that does not match the declared format is refused on the page) is not exercised here.
